| File | Triangles | Bytes |
|---|---:|---:|
| sedan.glb | 2,032 | 172,216 |
| suv.glb | 2,474 | 207,572 |
| hatchback-sports.glb | 2,088 | 197,804 |
| Textures/colormap.png (shared) | — | 12,371 |

GLBs and texture are unmodified originals. Total asset payload: **589,963 bytes**.
SHA-256 pins and individual sources are in manifest.json. Triangle counts come from
summing indexed TRIANGLES primitive accessor counts / 3 in each actual GLB.
The prototype normalizes dimensions at runtime, maps surfaces to our car-paint,
window and tyre reflectance, and suppresses asset emission. The original analytic
lamps, taillamps, plates and red reflectors are retained separately.
